title.narrative: Development of a high-integrity Benefit Sharing Agreement (BSA) for blue carbon projects

description.narrative:
FSD Africa’s support through this grant will allow Blue to develop innovative benefits sharing and financing solutions for blue carbon projects. Blue’s objective is to use its current projects in Sierra Leone and Guinea as proofs-of-concept for high quality, financially sustainable projects to help build the market and catalyze investment into the sector.
Through this project FSD Africa will work with Blue on the development of a high-integrity Benefit Sharing Agreement (BSA) for blue carbon projects, with a focus on governance and financial frameworks. Scope of work involved the following four workstreams: 1) Conducting a Market Review, 2) Conducting a Key Component Analysis, 3) Develop High-Integrity Principles, and 4) Design Frameworks.
